items.heading: Langouste a la Vanille
details: Key ingredients: lobster, vanilla, coconut milk, tomato
Saute lobster pieces briefly until they turn pink.
Simmer coconut milk with tomato and a split vanilla pod.
Return the lobster to the fragrant sauce.
Cook gently until the sauce thickens and serve with rice.

items.heading: Pilao
details: Key ingredients: rice, meat, cloves, cinnamon, onion
Brown meat with onion and whole spices until fragrant.
Add rice and stir to coat in the spiced fat.
Pour in stock and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer until the rice is tender and fluffy.

items.heading: Mataba
details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.
Prepare and cut the main ingredients.
Sauté or toast the aromatics and spices, add the main ingredients and cook using the traditional simmering, steaming, baking or grilling method until done.
